scope: production endpoint with host transport substitutes
checks: PASS authorization, per-peer read budget and unrelated-client usability
PASS pending success loses data on revoke before mailbox publication
PASS grant revision cannot bless a capture made under an older grant
PASS explicit retirement reclaims capacity; exec identity needs fresh authority
PASS malformed requests and repeated sequences never trigger capture; malformed provider fails closed
PASS stale preconditions and exact/late deadlines discard pending observations
PASS malformed infinite deadline cannot retain a blocked reply beyond the service budget
PASS exec-preserved endpoint cannot reuse old image authority or publish an older pending success
PASS defensive peer change during capture retires the route before any success publication
PASS ordinary client drives one bounded exchange; no retry after unresponsive service
PASS client verifies both peer routes and reports changed service epoch without capture
